messages:
juno: quick heads-up from an overnight profile on canary (post-2.1.5). decode stalls when requests hit tool/fn pauses, lots of tiny batches and kernel churn. short summary below.

bench-bot: perf-snippet: p95 +15% on tool-interleaved traces, batch-fragmentation ratio spikes ~3x at function-return boundaries, KV cache hit drops ~5% during pause windows.

rachel: can you paste a minimal trace so we can see ordering of events?

juno: abridged trace:
```
T0: R1 starts decode -> emits tokens -> invokes tool (pause ~420ms)
T420: tool returns -> R1 resumes but continuous-batcher opens new batch (size 1) -> kernel switches to short-kernel -> more context switches
T425: R2 (no tool) arrives, picked different kernel -> interleaved small kernels for few steps -> thrash
```

omar: looks like two linked problems: the batch-commit heuristic closes on stop-token/tool-expectation, and kernel selection reacts to the tiny batch/seq-len shift. also noted KV frame reattach cost when the tool result includes structured frames.

lee: proposal: introduce a short commit-debounce when a toolcall is detected (50ms) to let other in-flight requests join; and nudge token_budget_target down for tool-heavy routes (96 -> 72) so we don't default to the smallest kernels as often.

bench-bot: quick A/B on q-tools-7 with hold_ms=50 and token_budget_target=72 (30m):
``
before: p95=225ms p99=610ms kv_hit=87% thr=1020r/s
after:  p95=198ms p99=545ms kv_hit=90% thr=995r/s
```

rachel: those tradeoffs look promising for chat/interactive UX. throughput hit is small. we should avoid applying to bulk-generation routes.

omar: extra heuristic: if a tool returns structured output that advertises a stop_token or a finish marker, delay enforcing the stop-token flush until KV reattach completes (cap 80ms). prevents immediate tiny-batch commit.

lee: implementation notes: continuous-batcher route config additions: `tool_hold_ms`, `tool_token_budget`, `kernel_stability_hint`. runtime router will tag routes with `may_invoke_tool=true`.

rachel: add telemetry: `kernel_swap_count`, `batch_fragmentation_ratio`, `kv_hit_before_after_tool_ms`, and tag traces with `tool_wait_ms`. make sure we can slice by route metadata.

juno: action items:
- juno: draft RFC + perf task with the 30m A/B numbers and the trace snippet
- lee: prototype batch-debounce + route flags (small diff)
- omar: add KV-reattach guard for stop-token enforcement (80ms cap)
- rachel: extend perf harness to tag traces and ingest the new telemetry
- bench-bot: schedule 2h A/B on dedicated queue for long-run generation (opt-out)

lee: I'll roll a canary tomorrow AM on canary-12. ping me when you want me to flip.

juno: thanks folks. cc @eng-runtime :eyes:

perf-bot: linked draft: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pulls/4291 (draft) — includes hold_ms, route flags, KV stop-token guard, and tests.
